// PROBE FIXTURE — the positive control. Identical shape to the negative probe,
// except the authorization call is real code rather than a comment.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { getPolicyAccess } from "@/lib/policy-access"

export async function GET(_req: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
    const { id } = await params
    const access = await getPolicyAccess(id, "user-from-session")
    if (!access.canRead) return new Response("Not found", { status: 404 })

    const rows = await db.$queryRawUnsafe(
        "SELECT * FROM policy_documents WHERE policy_id = $1",
        id
    )
    return Response.json({ rows })
}
